decided: When a project signs off once per program, orbit does not offer to mark the program's last stage complete until the user has signed the program brief, whatever the pull request setting; with one pull request for the whole program, it also holds back making that pull request ready. With a pull request per change, or none, the brief tells the user the work has already landed.
alternatives: refuse once-per-program sign-off unless the project uses one pull request for the whole program
warn and let the sign-off hold nothing when there is no program pull request
why: Holding the program's completion works under every pull request setting, so the sign-off setting does not depend on another setting, and the brief is honest about what can still be stopped.
